Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in White Bear Lake for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The season runs from December 5 (WinterFest in downtown White Bear Lake and the free Festival of Trees open house with Santa, also December 12) to December 8 (Children's Storytime with Santa at the Fillebrown House), with horse drawn trolley rides, carolers and an Elf Hunt along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in White Bear Lake

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in White Bear Lake
  • 2 free events: WinterFest in downtown White Bear Lake and the Festival of Trees open house with Santa
  • Meet Santa: Santa at 4 Deuces Saloon during WinterFest, free photos at the Festival of Trees and Santa's storytime on December 8
  • Parades and tree lightings: none verified
  • Trains: none verified; horse drawn trolley rides run at WinterFest
  • Season: December 5 to December 12, 2026
